CheckSmsVerifyCode.description_en: Verifies an SMS verification code and returns the verification result
CheckSmsVerifyCode.description_zh: 核验短信验证码并返回核验是否成功的结果

CreateSchemeConfig.description_en: Creates a code for a converged communication authentication service
CreateSchemeConfig.description_zh: 融合认证方案用于标识App下的认证场景，一般一个认证方案对应一个App包名、包签名。调用本接口创建融合认证方案并获取方案Code

CreateVerifyScheme.description_en: A verification scheme identifies authentication scenarios for an application (App). Each scheme typically corresponds to an App name, App package name, and package signature. The required parameters vary depending on the access terminal. You can call this API to create a verification scheme
CreateVerifyScheme.description_zh: 认证方案用于标识App下的认证场景，一般一个认证方案对应一个App名称、App包名、包签名等信息（接入端不同对应所需参数也不同），调用本接口创建认证方案

DeleteVerifyScheme.description_en: If you no longer need a verification scheme, you can call this operation or delete the scheme in the Phone Number Verification Service console
DeleteVerifyScheme.description_zh: 如果您不再使用某个认证方案，需要删除方案时，调用此接口或在号码认证服务控制台删除认证方案

DescribeVerifyScheme.description_en: Queries the details of a verification service
DescribeVerifyScheme.description_zh: 调用其他API接口时会用到认证方案密钥等参数信息，本接口用于获取认证方案密钥信息

GetAuthToken.description_en: Obtain an authorization token for H5 native number verification. The response includes an AccessToken and a JwtToken
GetAuthToken.description_zh: 获取授权Token用于H5本机号码校验的鉴权，返回结果包括AccessToken和JwtToken

GetFusionAuthToken.description_en: After the fusion authentication client completes initialization, you can call this API from your server to obtain an authentication token. You can then pass the authentication token to the SDK for authentication
GetFusionAuthToken.description_zh: 融合认证客户端完成初始化操作后，由开发者服务器发起调用此接口，获取鉴权Token。获取到的鉴权Token用于传入SDK进行鉴权

GetMobile.description_en: This API retrieves a mobile phone number using the one-click login feature of the Phone Number Verification Service. If the call is successful, the mobile phone number is returned
GetMobile.description_zh: 本接口用于号码认证服务端一键登录取号，成功取得号码后会将号码返回

GetPhoneWithToken.description_en: Obtains a phone number for one-click logon. This operation is exclusive to HTML5 pages
GetPhoneWithToken.description_zh: 本接口用于号码认证服务端（H5能力专用）一键登录取号，成功取得号码后会将号码返回

QueryGateVerifyBillingPublic.description_en: You can call this API to query monthly billing details for a specific authentication method
QueryGateVerifyBillingPublic.description_zh: 调用此接口查询某种认证方式下的月份费用账单

QueryGateVerifyStatisticPublic.description_en: Queries the calls of Phone Number Verification Service
QueryGateVerifyStatisticPublic.description_zh: 调用此接口查看统计日期范围内，某个认证方式的总调用量、调用成功量、调用失败量、调用未知量，及每一天的用量统计

VerifyMobile.description_en: Call this operation to verify the phone number of the current device. It returns the verification result
VerifyMobile.description_zh: 调用本接口进行本机号码校验认证，认证完成后返回认证结果

VerifyPhoneWithToken.description_en: Call this API to verify phone numbers on H5 pages and retrieve the verification result when the operation completes
VerifyPhoneWithToken.description_zh: 调用本接口进行H5页面本机号码校验认证，认证完成后返回认证结果

VerifyWithFusionAuthToken.description_en: Obtains the verification results by using the verification token that is obtained by using the authentication token
VerifyWithFusionAuthToken.description_zh: 融合认证客户端发起认证时，由开发者服务器通过鉴权Token换取的认证Token向阿里云发起本次调用，获取认证结果
